ترتكسون (form VIII)
# تَرْتَكِسُونَ (tartakisūna) /tar.ta.ki.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# تُرْتَكَسُونَ (turtakasūna) /tur.ta.ka.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
